seriesTitle: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: an Almost History of America

episodes.title: Livingston
episodes.summary: Robert Livingston takes a first pass at the Declaration of Independence. Rosa Parks settles in for an uncomfortable bus ride.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.summary: Meriwether Lewis shares news of his upcoming travels with his long-suffering wife. Larry presses George Washington for answers.

episodes.title: McCarthy
episodes.summary: Larry crashes a party in Boston Harbor. Jonesy makes a stop on the Underground Railroad. The Wright Brothers prepare for their first flight. Senator Joe McCarthy calls out his fellow congressmen for their problematic conduct.

episodes.title: Deepthroat
episodes.summary: Bob Woodward receives some questionable intel. Henry Ford is forced to take a local mensch out for a test drive. Bachelor president James Buchanan tries his luck with the ladies. Vaccine pioneer Jonas Salk makes his mother a little too proud.

episodes.title: Lincoln
episodes.summary: Larry plays a key role during the showdown at the O.K. Corral. President Lincoln receives advice from his Chief of Staff, Lawrence Butterfield. President Johnson recruits Butterfield to help convince a grieving Mary Todd to move out of the White House.

episodes.title: Buzz
episodes.summary: Larry prepares to flee after Paul Revere rides through town. The Apollo 11 astronauts butt heads during their lunar mission.

episodes.title: Lawrence
episodes.summary: Larry gets carried away on VJ Day. Rescuers question the Donner Party. President Obama receives dubious fashion advice.
